free.name: Free

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
This service (ClaudeWizard) is provided AS IS.

Generated config files are templates and are not guaranteed to be suitable for any specific project. The operator is not liable for any damages arising from the use of generated files.

You are responsible for managing your own API keys. API keys are held only in your browser session and are never sent to any server.

This service complies with Anthropic's usage policies (BYOK model).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This service uses Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for access analytics.

[Data collected]
Page views and event data via GA4 (anonymized)

[Data NOT collected]
API keys, license keys, and wizard inputs are never sent to our servers.

[Cookies]
GA4 uses cookies. You can opt out via your browser settings.

[Third parties]
Google LLC (data processing)
